title: lycopus lucidus subsp. americanus
intro: Lycopus lucidus subsp. americanus, commonly known as American bugleweed, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating anxiety, insomnia, and hyperthyroidism due to its ability to stimulate the thyroid gland and calm the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of American bugleweed are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-anxiety properties. These constituents contribute to the plant's ability to regulate hormonal imbalances, reduce stress, and promote relaxation.
